theme: Luxury Dark Mode with Electric Cyan and Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) + Electric Cyan #00E5FF & Gold Accents
components: Admin Dashboard with Metrics & Quick Actions
Registration Management (Full CRUD, Filters, Passcode/QR Generation)
CSV/XLSX Import Preview & Validation Modal (6 Required Columns: Full Name, Email, Ticket Type, Organization, Phone, Seat/Table)
Event Configuration Panel (Title, Date, Time, Venue, Max Capacity, Active Gates)
Live Scanner Gate Interface (Continuous Browser Camera QR Scanning + Manual Passcode Lookup + Atomic Duplicate Prevention)
Reports & Audit Logs Viewer (Real-time scan attempts, success/failure metrics, exportable CSV)
Role Management (Admin vs Scanner Device Roles with PIN/Auth token headers)
Pass & Email Center (SMTP Config simulation, PDF Pass Generation, QR Code view & download)
qr_concurrency_strategy: MongoDB atomic findOneAndUpdate with status/scan_count check ensuring single-pass entry even across multiple concurrent scanner devices at the physical gate.
csv_import_strategy: Client-side PapaParse or robust server-side text line parser for 6 columns (Full Name, Email, Ticket Type, Organization, Phone, Seat/Table) with live validation preview table showing duplicate/missing data before batch insertion.
pass_email_strategy: Server-side qrcode generation + ReportLab PDF pass generation + simulated or configured SMTP email dispatch with direct inline QR code and secure ticket link.
deployment_architecture: React SPA (Frontend) communicating with FastAPI (Backend) backed by MongoDB with REST endpoints and WebSocket/Polling sync for live gate counts.
universal_guidelines: Every interactive element MUST include data-testid attribute
Never use complete transparent background in headers or overlays
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) and avoid Inter for headings
Ensure all scan responses and error toasts provide distinct visual feedback for success vs duplicate vs invalid pass
All .js files used for React components
